notes.title: Kira's dark story is complete! - FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
Kira's dark story is complete with 40% Discount on Full Game Release!

Can you help Kira to find answers for her questions? Take on mysterious technology in a thrilling platformer. Meet hundreds of prepared challenges in Dark Minute: Kira's Adventure Full release from KovalGames.


 Kira's story is complete in 101 dark levels.
 After 60 seconds the light turns off...
 You need to find 3 energy cells to open the exit.
 Discover unknown dungeons, explore underwater mazes and missions.
 Collect alien artifacts.
 Play on PC, MacOS and Linux!


Help Kira explore this dark underworld...

notes.title: Version 0.3.4.0 is uploaded!
notes.notes:
Hi, what changed in 0.3.4.0 version?
--------
- now you can change the keys to your own in the main menu (jump, use and dash) - test version!
- upgraded portaits in all dialogues
- minor changes in 24 level with destructable platforms
- little changes in camera background
- other small bugs fixed

Please write your suggestions and opinions to this version!

notes.title: Version 0.3.3.0 version has been published!
notes.notes:
0.3.3.0 (PC)
- eliminated the problem of "double taking" Energy Cells in levels
- level 3 - spikes in level repaired
- level 4 - problem with stairs fixed
- level 5 - some stairs and walls problem fixed
- level 6 - walls problem fixed
- level 7 - first elevator fixed
- level 8 - elevators fixed
- level 9 - hanging obstacle fixed
- level 11 - water and swimming fixed in this level
- language bugs fixed
- now you do not accidentally press the space bar in the main menu and start new game
- now after entering Exit, player can't move Kira
- minor bugs fixed.

Mac version 0.3.3.0 - we will upload today too! 

We are still working hard!

Best!
Lucas
